name: Curriculum Design
description: Design a course from observable outcomes through assessment, learning sequence, practice, accessibility, feedback, and evidence-based revision.

tasks.name: Define learners and constraints
tasks.objective: Identify target learners, prior knowledge, motivation, context, accessibility/language needs, delivery format, time, resources, credential or standards requirements, and real-world performance expected after the course.

tasks.name: Write observable outcomes
tasks.objective: Define what learners must be able to retrieve, explain, discriminate, perform, create, or transfer; set mastery evidence and distinguish essential outcomes from enrichment.

tasks.name: Design assessment before lessons
tasks.objective: Create authentic tasks, retrieval checks, rubrics, examples, cumulative transfer tests, and accommodations that directly measure the outcomes without rewarding irrelevant polish.

tasks.name: Build learning sequence
tasks.objective: Map prerequisites, concept dependencies, worked examples, fading support, practice spacing/interleaving, misconceptions, and transitions from explanation to independent performance.

tasks.name: Produce learning materials
tasks.objective: Create concise instruction, examples/nonexamples, practice, feedback, projects, references, facilitator notes, and accessible alternatives. Keep AI-generated material source-checked and aligned to outcomes.

tasks.name: Pilot with learners
tasks.objective: Observe completion, misconceptions, cognitive overload, pacing, accessibility failures, assessment validity, and transfer. Collect learning evidence rather than satisfaction alone.

tasks.name: Revise and maintain
tasks.objective: Revise weak sequence/material/assessment links from evidence; document version, prerequisites, instructor assumptions, and update triggers for content or standards changes.
